name: @commitscape/builder
description: The Builder: takes Builds from the queue, runs commitscape on a clone, loads its Stored Index into Postgres and its pack into R2.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/builder.mjs --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire as bannerRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = bannerRequire(import.meta.url);"
